 Alijah Martin Scores 12 in Raptors' Loss to Celtics on Wednesday
 In the Raptors' 93-98 loss to the Celtics, Alijah Martin contributed 12 points on 4-5 shooting from both the field and beyond the arc, added 2 steals, 1 rebound, and played 15...
 Alijah Martin 
 Toronto Raptors ·
 November 11, 2026 · 1 min read 
 In the Raptors' 93-98 loss to the Celtics, Alijah Martin contributed 12 points on 4-5 shooting from both the field and beyond the arc, added 2 steals, 1 rebound, and played 15 minutes.
 Insight
 Martin contributed 12 points on an efficient 4-5 shooting from the field, including 4-5 from beyond the arc in 15 minutes against the Celtics. This performance aligns with his strong shooting efficiency, as evidenced by his 67.6% field goal percentage for the season. Additionally, Martin recorded 2 steals and secured 1 rebound in the game.
